Let $AB=AC=R,$ and set $\angle ABC=\angle ACB=\theta.$  Then $BC=2R\cos\theta$, and placing $A$ at the origin, $B=(R,0)$, $C=(-R\cos2\theta,R\sin2\theta)$.  Writing 
$$E=(2R\cos\theta,0),\qquad D=t\bigl(-R\cos2\theta,R\sin2\theta\bigr),$$ 
the conditions $ED=BC$ and $DB=BC$ force 
$$t=-4\cos\theta\cos2\theta,\quad32\cos^5\theta-32\cos^3\theta+6\cos\theta-1=0.$$ 
The physical root in $(0,1)$ is $\cos\theta\approx0.22255$, so 
$$\theta\approx77.142857^\circ=\frac{540}{7}^\circ.$$ 
Hence $m=540,n=7$, and $m+n=547.$
